first.rationale: Memory_73 needs verification because promotional pricing showed strong acquisition lift but the readout had pooled cohorts post-redefinition—critical to understand before competing on price. Memory_86 directly tracked onboarding shortening and completion lift, relevant to the current 4% QoQ decline. Simplifying onboarding targets the measurable activation and completion declines (−6% and −4% QoQ) via durable mechanisms shown in memory_31 and memory_86. This preserves focus on qualified revenue over race-to-the-bottom pricing. A small guarded test allows validation before full rollout and leaves optionality if promotional pricing verification surfaces new learnings. Referral incentives and activation messaging are secondary given the structural onboarding friction signal in the data.
